Overview

Resistencia is a city in Chaco with a population of 410,698. Chaco’s capital known as the City of Sculptures, with the largest open-air sculpture museum in Latin America. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
